mentions.story: What is the difference between deep learning and usual machine learning?
mentions.text:
More specifically techniques such as Momentumn [course] (great article visualizing the problem space discussed above) and thigns like RMSPROP [link] are used.

The rectified linear unit also converges about 75% faster than the classic Sigmoid or Tanh. the ReLu is F(x) = max(0, x) so the gradient propogated is 1 rather than a more "curvy" value.
